name: List All Vendors Notes
description: Returns all vendor notes that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[VendorId]
queryFilters.description: Filter vendor notes by vendor unique identifier. All GET requests must include a filter for [VendorId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter vendor notes updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [VendorId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message related to the vendor. A vendor note cannot exceed 65,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The vendor to which the note will be attached

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the vendor note's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the vendor. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
